_note: The 4 cars in our test environment. Each 'schedule' entry is taken from that car's owner's manual (normal driving conditions): 'action' is what the manual says to do (replace, inspect or rotate), and 'km'/'months' is the interval, whichever comes first (0 = the manual gives no limit of that kind). Where the manual says 'first at X, then every Y', km/months is the first change and repeat_km/repeat_months the interval after that. 'note' quotes the manual where it helps. 'year' is the model year: no service can be dated before 1 January of that year. 'manual' is the PDF the AI reads; 'schedule_source' says which schedule and pages the numbers come from.

cars.schedule_source: Owner's manual, Maintenance Schedule, except South African models (printed pp. 377-380), normal conditions; Singaporean models are listed in the Specifications section.

Engine Oil.note: Normal: replace every 10,000 km or 1 year

Brake Pads.note: Manual: inspect front and rear brakes every 10,000 km or 1 year; the car has front disc brakes and rear drum brakes

Tyres.note: Rotate every 10,000 km; check tyre inflation and condition at least once per month

Engine Air Filter.note: Replace air cleaner element every 30,000 km for non-Indian models

Coolant.note: First at 200,000 km or 10 years, then every 100,000 km or 5 years

cars.schedule_source: Owner's manual, Scheduled Maintenance, U.S.A. and Puerto Rico, normal driving (pp. 6-4 to 6-5): each interval = 16,000 km or 12 months.

Engine Oil.note: When the wrench indicator comes on, at most 16,000 km or 12 months; severe driving: 8,000 km or 6 months

Brake Pads.note: Manual: inspect disc brakes at every interval

Coolant.note: First at 192,000 km or 120 months, then every 96,000 km or 60 months

cars.schedule_source: Owner's manual, Normal Maintenance Schedule - Gasoline Engine (Except Europe), except Middle East (pp. 9-14 to 9-17); Tire rotation (p. 9-41). Spark plugs: 2.0 MPI / Smartstream G1.6, unleaded fuel.

Brake Pads.note: Manual: inspect disc brakes and pads

Tyres.note: Or sooner if irregular wear develops

Engine Air Filter.note: Also inspect every 15,000 km or 12 months

Coolant.note: First at 200,000 km or 10 years, then every 40,000 km or 24 months

cars.schedule_source: Owner's manual (USA edition), Normal maintenance schedule - Non Turbo Models, 2.0 MPI (p. 8-12).

Brake Pads.note: Manual: inspect brake discs and pads

Engine Air Filter.note: Also inspect every 13,000 km or 12 months

Coolant.note: First at 195,000 km or 120 months, then every 39,000 km or 24 months
